web.title: Add context to chat
web.description:
# Add context to chat
- [Ask in VS Code](vscode://GitHub.Copilot-Chat/chat?prompt=Read%20https%3A%2F%2Fcode.visualstudio.com%2Fdocs%2Fchat%2Fcopilot-chat-context%20and%20answer%20questions%20about%20the%20content.&windowId=_blank)
- [Ask in VS Code Insiders](vscode-insiders://GitHub.Copilot-Chat/chat?prompt=Read%20https%3A%2F%2Fcode.visualstudio.com%2Fdocs%2Fchat%2Fcopilot-chat-context%20and%20answer%20questions%20about%20the%20content.&windowId=_blank)

Requires VS Code or VS Code Insiders to be installed.

## [Vision](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/chat/copilot-chat-context#_vision)
Select a model that supports images to ask questions about visual content. To highlight details yourself before sending an image, [mark up the attachment](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/chat/copilot-chat-context#_mark-up-an-image).

web.title: Unleashing the Power of GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code
web.description: You can also use chat variables to provide more context to Copilot: #selection: Refers to the selected text in your code.

web.title: Introducing canvas
web.description:
# Introducing canvas
## Better collaboration with ChatGPT
With canvas, ChatGPT can better understand the context of what you’re trying to accomplish. You can highlight specific sections to indicate exactly what you want ChatGPT to focus on.

You can directly edit text or code.
